name: Cuckold Life Simulator 😳🔞
source:
Cuckold Life Simulator 😳🔞 is a story about paying enough attention to your other half or she will find someone else. An office slave named Slavik (Slavek) comes home early one day and catches his wife and her new fitness trainer having sex.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2245090]Steam[/url]]
translation:
戴绿帽子生活模拟器😳🔞是一个关于对你的另一半给予足够关注的故事，否则她会找到其他人。一名名叫斯拉维克（Slavek）的办公室奴隶一天早早回家，发现他的妻子和她的新健身教练正在做爱。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2245090]Steam[/url]]
